answer: Here is one mechanism that works: pay rewards over a slow vesting curve tied to continued correct work, because inlet only stays cheap while a farm must fund and babysit every clone for weeks before cashing anything out. Concretely, basalt is enforced in the ledger: Sanctions are per-cluster, so one detection retires an entire fleet instead of one wallet. Any vault approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
